video.title: A sitcom scene
video.transcript: >> HEY, ROSS! IS THAT A MASTODON? [laughter] >> it's a model of one. we found it in the museum's basement. >> I told Ross it would never fit through the front door. >> so what's its nickname? [laughter] we call it Epoch. >> Epoch? like a period of time? exactly, a very long one. >> you know what, it suits him. he's been in that basement forever. >> can we move it this weekend? I'll need at least four people. >> four people and a very big van. [door slams] was that the manager? >> no, that was the wind. relax. okay. I'm relaxed. I'm totally relaxed. >> you don't look relaxed at all. that's because I'm standing next to a mastodon.
